label: Claude Code Access
description: A Claude Code login, for the ClaudeCode nodes' `access`: your Claude subscription (a token `claude setup-token` prints; on a local install only, so the token stays on your own machine) or an Anthropic API key (anywhere). One access for however many ClaudeCode nodes.

steps: On a machine where Claude Code is installed and you are logged in with a Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise plan, run `claude setup-token` in a terminal.
It opens a browser to sign in and prints a token that lasts a year.
Paste the token below and name the connection. It is offered on a local install only: Anthropic does not let other products offer the claude.ai login, so the token stays on your own machine.
Open console.anthropic.com, Settings > API Keys, and create an API key.
Paste it below and name the connection. Calls are billed to that API account.

outputs.name: access
outputs.description: Wire into the ClaudeCode nodes' `access` input.
